items.title: Ancient Egypt World
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Ancient Egypt World has massive Egyptian themed structures. Travel back in time and discover the lost Egypt civilization.

+ Massive open world to explore
+ Great for survival or roleplay
+ Single player or multiplayer

items.title: Space Race
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description: Welcome to the space race! This popular intergalactic race brings in life forms from every corner of the universe! Astronauts, aliens and even more unknown monstrous creatures! The space race is a once in a lifetime event, so you better not miss it. I have just one question for you, are you ready?

items.title: Fall Hoodies
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: It's that time of year when you put on your hoodie and love every minute of it! These adorable hoodies will keep you warm during the cold months! Creeper is wearing a hoodie, Enderman is wearing one too and so can you with these cute fall themed skins!

items.title: Neon Dark Demons
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: These glowing demons from darkness shine bright in the dark! They glow in different bright colors and patterns. Use these skins to stand out among other dark demons!

items.title: BriannaPlayz School Roleplay
items.creator: FireGames
items.description:
Brianna’s school is back in session! Pick from school uniforms, colorful outfits, or sport uniforms. Perfect for school roleplay!

- 1 free Brianna skin
- 23 total skins

By BriannaPlayz & CinemaCraft

items.title: Spy Agent
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: When there is an undercover and top secret mission, call upon the mob spy agents for the job! They do flips and special tricks! Dodging all sorts of high tech traps and alarms.

items.title: Hacker Mansion
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
You will always be safe in this Hacker Mansion! Efficiency, Fortune or Sharpness 1000? In this mansion, you'll find the best armor and tools!

+ Highly enchanted armor, weapons and tools!
By Street Studios
items.changelog:
- Fixed all enchanted armor parts, tools and weapons and added new ones!
- Placed the base into a new custom survival world

items.title: Back to School
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Summer vacation is about to come to an end! Schools are opening and now it's time to dress accordingly! All of the skins in this pack are great for school, pick your favorite now and start your school adventure!

+ Perfect for roleplay
+ 12 unique student skins including 2 that are FREE!

items.title: Magma Runner +
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Stretch those legs and get ready to sprint through this fiery runner map to reach the bottom before you're drowned in lava! Master the procedurally generated levels, then design your own! Just bring some good shoes, because it's about to get hot.

- Includes 5 skins!
- Features 4 games modes, 13 themes, a level creator, and high scores
- By Rogue_Baron & Pathway Studios

items.title: Elegant Anime Teens
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
You will be the coolest player in the game with the most elegant and cute anime skins in this pack! Pick the skin you like the most and start impressing people now! 

+ 22 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Anime themed
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Pretty In Purple
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Do you love purple? If so, this pack is perfect for you! Choose your favorite skin from this pack designed with the sweetness of purple color and amaze other players!

+ 14 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: City Teens
items.creator: Cynosia
items.description:
Do you want to impress the entire city with your new look? This is the skin pack for you! Great for roleplay with friends!

+ 8 skins
+ Great for roleplay
+ Lots of color options
+ Made by Artifact Studios

items.title: Skyblock Factory
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
Build your own skyblock factory with all these craftable machines! These machines can automatically farm, mine, spawn monsters and even collect blocks!

- 30 craftable machines
- 1.17 custom skyblock world
- Multiplayer friendly

items.title: Underwater Teens
items.creator: FTB
items.description:
Make a splash with this ocean themed skin pack of underwater teens!

+ 10 epic skins
+ Represent your favorite ocean creature
+ 1 FREE skin: Axolotl

By FTB

items.title: Hoodie Squad
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
No matter what time of year, there's always time to get cozy while staying trendy. Show off your personal style with a hoodie and be the life of the party! 

- 24 Stylish Skins!
- A variety of styles and aesthetics for everyone!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Cool Demons
items.creator: Glowfischdesigns
items.description:
Demons walk among us, and they do it in style.
Would you rather look like a duke, or feel like an arch demon?
Lets all be unique together and become one of coolest dark lords ever!

+ 2 free skins.
+ 14 epic Skins!

items.title: Difficulty: Caves Only!
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Survive in just a cave with Difficulty: Caves Only!

items.title: Neon Beats
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description: Shine like never before with these bright colourful neon skins.

items.title: Millionaire Resort!
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Have an amazing vacation at this luxurious resort! Rest in mansions, stay on the beach, or go to the pool with your friends!

+ By Street Studios

items.title: Billionaire Tree House
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: A mansion built in a giant tree for billionaires! Enjoy all of this amazing build with Billionaire Tree House!

items.title: Lucky Block!
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Lucky Blocks are everywhere! Test your luck and beware of unlucky outcomes!

+ Lucky blocks spawn naturally!
+ Survive in a custom spawn!

items.title: PLANES
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
+ Realistic Planes
+ 15x Custom Airplanes!
+ 11x Ground Safety Vehicles!
+ Modern Airports & Planes!
+ Custom Events & Quests!
+ 1000x1000 Modern World!

items.title: Pirate Secret Base
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Ahoy mateys! There's only one thing pirates love more than gold. An underground secret base! Enchanting tables, farms, ender chests, a nether portal, clusters of gold and diamond ore, this base has it all!

+ Skull island with ports and ships
+ Underground base
+ Buried treasure
+ By ArgoStudios and 4KS Studios

items.title: Craftable Houses
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Enjoy Minecraft survival but with a twist! Craft many different types of houses from a modern mansion to a treehouse with your friends! Build a neighborhood or travel with a new home in your inventory!

+ 15 different houses
+ Custom crafting recipes
+ By ArgoStudios and 4KS Studios
